newsitem.title: USA: Average American to spend $765 on holiday gifts.
newsitem.headline: Average American to spend $765 on holiday gifts.

text.p: It's jingle bells time again, but the ringing of cash registers may not be so merry for retailers since shoppers are expected to hold holiday spending steady with last year, a survey said Friday.
The average American is likely to spend $765 on holiday gifts, unchanged from last year, according to MasterCard, the credit card company.

The survey comes on the heels of Thursday's Commerce Department report that showed tight-fisted consumers spent just slightly more in October than they did the previous month. The report prompted analysts to predict the holiday shopping season may be less robust than expected.

When making holiday purchases this year, 34 percent of those surveyed by Mastercard said they will use a bank credit card. The shopping survey said 31 percent of those surveyed plan to pay with checks and 29 percent plan to pay with cash.
Amid all this spending, fewer than 50 percent of Americans set a holiday budget.

Respondents said they were more likely to use credit cards for holiday purchases if they received an additional store discount (65 percent). Other incentives would include getting a rebate with their statement (50 percent) and a purchase protection plan (45 percent).
Procrastinators were in good company, the survey showed, because 20 percent of holiday shoppers plan to finish their Christmas shopping the day before the holiday.
